description: One labelled batch of provider and customer accounts, with the same fields the admin 'Scan accounts' button builds from the database (email, phone, completed bookings, reviews written, distinct providers reviewed). Labels come from the scenario each account was written to represent, assigned before the detector was run. 'reviewedProviderIds' was added with v2 of the detector and follows the scenario text: sock puppets review the copycat provider fp01, the two-account person boosts a friend (p06), and review farms spread across established providers.
